thread:
anya - PM: Quick: propose a slim rollout playbook for Optimize recommendations (batch/cache/quant). Keep pilot small and reversible.

sam - Eng: Agreed. Tech plan: int8-only, per-tenant feature flag, recs tagged with {quant,batch,cache}.

li - ML: Quality gate: per-tenant canonical eval, plus 1% sampled A/B comparisons. Pause if concordance drop >1.5%.

maria - Solutions: Customer-facing: "why this rec" field + one-click opt-out. Pilot customers must get daily digest.

ops-bot: deploy 5401234600 -> canary to optimize-pilot

anya - PM: Acceptance floors: >=6% token savings median, concordance delta <=1.5%, error rate delta <=0.1%. Rollback tested in staging.

sam - Eng: We'll emit audit events and keep detailed logs for 72h, then roll-up. Feature flag per-tenant + auto-pause rule.

li - ML: Add per-sample surprise check: if token-level surprise increases above threshold, suppress rec.

maria - Solutions: I'll recruit 2 pilot customers and draft the FAQ. Recommend explicit opt-in for regulated tenants.

anya - PM: Owners: maria outreach by Mon, sam runtime + tagging by Thu, li eval hook by Thu, ops to monitor canary. Reconvene Fri sync.
